topics.title: HTML Fundamentals
topics.description: Semantic markup, accessibility, and document structure.
topics.content:
The Building Blocks of the Web

HTML provides the structure and content that browsers render.

Semantic Elements

  • <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <aside>, <footer>

Accessibility

  • Always include alt text for images
  • Use proper heading hierarchy
  • Add labels to form inputs

topics.title: CSS Fundamentals
topics.description: Selectors, box model, flexbox, and grid layouts.
topics.content:
Styling the Web

CSS controls visual presentation—colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts.

Layout Systems

  • Flexbox: One-dimensional layouts
  • Grid: Two-dimensional layouts

Modern CSS

  • CSS Variables (Custom Properties)
  • Container Queries
  • :has() selector

topics.title: JavaScript Essentials
topics.description: Variables, functions, DOM manipulation, and ES6+ features.
topics.content:
The Language of the Web

JavaScript brings interactivity to web pages.

Modern Features

  • Arrow functions, destructuring, spread operator
  • Promises and async/await
  • ES Modules (import/export)
  • Optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??)

topics.title: Responsive Design
topics.description: Media queries, mobile-first approach, and fluid layouts.
topics.content:
Designing for Every Screen

Responsive design ensures your site works on all devices.

Key Techniques

  • Mobile-first approach
  • Media queries
  • Fluid typography (clamp())
  • Container queries

topics.title: TypeScript
topics.description: Static typing, interfaces, generics, and type safety.
topics.content:
JavaScript with Types

TypeScript catches errors at compile time rather than runtime.

Key Concepts

  • Type annotations and inference
  • Interfaces and type aliases
  • Generics
  • Union and intersection types

topics.title: React.js
topics.description: Components, hooks, state management, and virtual DOM.
topics.content:
Building UIs with Components

React builds user interfaces through reusable components.

Key Concepts

  • Components and JSX
  • Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo)
  • Props and state
  • Server Components (React 19+)

topics.title: Svelte
topics.description: Reactive declarations, stores, and compile-time optimization.
topics.content:
Compiled Framework

Svelte shifts work from runtime to compile time for optimal performance.

Key Concepts

  • Reactive declarations ($:)
  • Stores for state management
  • Scoped CSS by default
  • SvelteKit for full-stack apps

topics.title: State Management
topics.description: Redux, Zustand, context patterns, and global state strategies.
topics.content:
Managing Application State

As apps grow, state management becomes critical.

Approaches

  • Local: useState, component state
  • Context: React Context, Svelte stores
  • External: Zustand, Jotai, Redux Toolkit
  • Server State: TanStack Query, SWR

topics.title: Build Tools & Bundlers
topics.description: Vite, Webpack, module bundling, and development workflows.
topics.content:
Modern Development Tooling

Build tools transform source code into optimized production bundles.

Popular Tools

  • Vite: Fast dev server, ESM-based
  • esbuild: Extremely fast bundler
  • Turbopack: Next.js bundler
  • Rollup: Library bundling

topics.title: Frontend Testing
topics.description: Unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end testing strategies.
topics.content:
Testing Your Code

Testing ensures reliability and prevents regressions.

Testing Pyramid

  • Unit: Individual functions/components
  • Integration: Component interactions
  • E2E: Full user flows

topics.title: Web Accessibility (a11y)
topics.description: WCAG guidelines, ARIA, and building inclusive experiences.
topics.content:
Building for Everyone

Accessibility ensures all users can access your content.

WCAG Principles (POUR)

  • Perceivable: Content must be presentable
  • Operable: UI must be operable
  • Understandable: Content must be clear
  • Robust: Works with assistive tech
